Flint + Steel Plate make a [[minecraft:flint_and_steel]].

intro.sv: Med Bronze Pickaxe och en het kiln öppnar sig fler malmer: bly och silver ur blyglans, guld, kalksten till flussmedel och salt som håller maten.
intro.en: With a Bronze Pickaxe and a hot kiln more ores open up: lead and silver from galena, gold, limestone for flux and salt that keeps food.

text.sv:
Bryt [[galena_ore]] med Bronze Pickaxe (vanlig under jord, mest kring y 16). Smält [[raw_galena]] i kilnen vid **800°** (Charcoal räcker) till [[lead_ingot]].

Silvret tas ut genom **kupellering**: Lead Ingot + Bone Meal → [[leaded_cupel]], som bränns vid **1000°** (Charcoal + Bellows) till 1 [[silver_nugget]]. 9 Silver Nugget → [[silver_ingot]], och på [[bronze_anvil]] blir en Silver Ingot **4 [[silver_coin]]** (4 slag).
text.en:
Mine [[galena_ore]] with a Bronze Pickaxe (common underground, most around y 16). Smelt [[raw_galena]] in the kiln at **800°** (Charcoal is enough) into a [[lead_ingot]].

Silver comes out by **cupellation**: Lead Ingot + Bone Meal → [[leaded_cupel]], fired at **1000°** (Charcoal + Bellows) into 1 [[silver_nugget]]. 9 Silver Nuggets → [[silver_ingot]], and on the [[bronze_anvil]] a Silver Ingot becomes **4 [[silver_coin]]s** (4 blows).

text.sv: Vaska grus och sand med [[pan]]: ibland ett [[minecraft:gold_nugget]], oftare vid åar och stränder. Gold Ore kräver fortfarande järnhacka. 9 Gold Nugget eller 1 [[minecraft:raw_gold]] smälts i kilnen vid **1100°** till en Gold Ingot (inte i vanillaugnar). På städet blir den **4 [[gold_coin]]**.
text.en: Pan gravel and sand with a [[pan]]: now and then a [[minecraft:gold_nugget]], more often by rivers and shores. Gold Ore still needs an iron pickaxe. 9 Gold Nuggets or 1 [[minecraft:raw_gold]] melt in the kiln at **1100°** into a Gold Ingot (not in vanilla furnaces). On the anvil it becomes **4 [[gold_coin]]s**.

text.sv:
[[limestone]] ligger i stora klumpar i berget, och syns i sluttningar och klippor. Krossa den på [[stone_anvil]] till **2 [[flux]]**, flussmedel till Bloomery.

[[rock_salt]] ligger djupt under öken, badlands och savann (Bronze Pickaxe) och ger 2–3 [[salt]]. Kött + Salt → [[salted_meat]] och fisk + Salt → [[salted_fish]] **ruttnar aldrig**. Scraped Hide + Salt → Leather direkt.
text.en:
[[limestone]] lies in big blobs in the rock and shows on hillsides and cliffs. Crush it on the [[stone_anvil]] into **2 [[flux]]**, flux for the Bloomery.

[[rock_salt]] lies deep under desert, badlands and savanna (Bronze Pickaxe) and gives 2–3 [[salt]]. Meat + Salt → [[salted_meat]] and fish + Salt → [[salted_fish]] **never spoil**. Scraped Hide + Salt → Leather at once.

text.sv:
Bränn [[limestone]], [[dolomite]] (ligger ihop med kalkstenen), [[chalk_block]], [[travertine]] (under åar, träsk och slätter) eller [[shell_bank]] (under stränder) i kilnen vid **900°** (Charcoal + Bellows) till [[quicklime]]. Quicklime + en hink vatten → [[slaked_lime]].

Slaked Lime + Sand + Gravel → **4 [[lime_mortar]]**. 4 av det ett tegel görs av + 1 Lime Mortar ger **dubbelt så mycket tegel**, för alla stenars Bricks och vanillas Stone, Deepslate och Mud Bricks. Murbruket krävs aldrig.

Slaked Lime + 2 Sand + Straw → **4 [[lime_plaster]]**, vita putsade väggar. 8 runt ett pigment färgar dem vita, svarta, röda eller gula. Scraped Hide + Slaked Lime → Leather, som med salt.

Utan Bellows: krossa [[gypsum]] på [[stone_anvil]] till [[gypsum_powder]] och bränn den vid **300°** till [[plaster_of_paris]]. Plaster of Paris + 2 Sand + Straw → 4 Lime Plaster, precis som Slaked Lime.
text.en:
Burn [[limestone]], [[dolomite]] (it lies with the limestone), a [[chalk_block]], [[travertine]] (under rivers, swamps and plains) or [[shell_bank]] (under beaches) in the kiln at **900°** (Charcoal + Bellows) into [[quicklime]]. Quicklime + a bucket of water → [[slaked_lime]].

Slaked Lime + Sand + Gravel → **4 [[lime_mortar]]**. 4 of what a bricks block is made from + 1 Lime Mortar gives **twice the bricks**, for every stone's Bricks and vanilla's Stone, Deepslate and Mud Bricks. Mortar is never required.

Slaked Lime + 2 Sand + Straw → **4 [[lime_plaster]]**, white plastered walls. 8 around a pigment dye them white, black, red or yellow. Scraped Hide + Slaked Lime → Leather, like salt.

Without Bellows: crush [[gypsum]] on the [[stone_anvil]] into [[gypsum_powder]] and burn it at **300°** into [[plaster_of_paris]]. Plaster of Paris + 2 Sand + Straw → 4 Lime Plaster, just like Slaked Lime.

text.sv:
Rosta [[alum_shale]] (svarta lager djupt under kalla biomer och i Galena Seams) i kilnen vid **800°** till [[roasted_alum_shale]] och laka den med en hink vatten: **2 [[alum]]**.

Alun är ett betningsmedel: **2 pigment + Alum → 4 dye**, dubbelt så mycket som pigmentet ger ensamt. Och ett garvsalt: **2 [[scraped_hide]] + Alum → 2 Leather**.
text.en:
Roast [[alum_shale]] (black layers deep under cold biomes and in the Galena Seams) in the kiln at **800°** into [[roasted_alum_shale]] and leach it with a bucket of water: **2 [[alum]]**.

Alum is a mordant: **2 pigment + Alum → 4 dye**, twice what the pigment gives alone. And a tawing salt: **2 [[scraped_hide]] + Alum → 2 Leather**.
